title: explicit -Port wins over the environment, then falls back to measured discovery
titleZh: 显式 -Port 压过环境变量,再回落到实测发现
why: defensive-spec section 1.2 in one case: an explicit parameter is level 1, so 50001 must be recorded as the configured port with source=param. Nothing listens on 50001, so level 4 (measured discovery) must kick in and find the DSH-owned loopback listener on 49999 - the report must show the configured value, the discovered value and the judged value separately, without guessing which one is right.
inject: DSH_WEB_URL points at 49999 while -Port 50001 is passed; only 49999 is actually listening
expectSummary: config dshPort=50001 source=param, discoveredPort=49999, judgedPort=49999, pass
